#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const double eps = 1e-8;
const double PI = acos(-1.0);

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}

    Point add(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
    }
    Point sub(const Point& o) const {
        return Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
    }
    Point rotate(double alpha) const {
        double c = cos(alpha);
        double s = sin(alpha);
        return Point(x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c);
    }
    Point norm() const {
        double len = length();
        return scale(1.0 / len);
    }
    Point scale(double f) const {
        return Point(f * x, f * y);
    }
    double length() const {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }

    bool operator==(const Point& o) const {
        return fabs(x - o.x) < eps && fabs(y - o.y) < eps;
    }
};

// Comparator for points with epsilon tolerance (mimics Java's compareTo)
struct PointComparator {
    bool operator()(const Point& a, const Point& b) const {
        if (fabs(a.x - b.x) > eps) return a.x < b.x;
        if (fabs(a.y - b.y) > eps) return a.y < b.y;
        return false; // considered equal
    }
};

struct Circle {
    Point o;
    double r;
    bool contains(const Point& p) const {
        double dist = p.sub(o).length();
        return fabs(dist - r) < eps;
    }
};

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, FastScanner& in, ostream& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        vector<Circle> circles(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int x = in.nextInt();
            int y = in.nextInt();
            int r = in.nextInt();
            circles[i].o = Point(x, y);
            circles[i].r = r;
        }

        // Collect all intersection points using a set with custom comparator
        set<Point, PointComparator> all;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                vector<Point> inter = intersect(circles[i], circles[j]);
                for (const Point& p : inter) {
                    all.insert(p);
                }
            }
        }

        // Map each point to its ID
        map<Point, int, PointComparator> pointId;
        vector<unordered_set<int>> adj;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            set<double> angleSet;
            int K = 100;
            for (int j = 0; j < K; ++j) {
                angleSet.insert(2 * PI * j / K);
            }
            for (const Point& p : all) {
                if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                    double dx = p.x - circles[i].o.x;
                    double dy = p.y - circles[i].o.y;
                    double alpha = atan2(dy, dx);
                    if (alpha < 0) alpha += 2 * PI;
                    angleSet.insert(alpha);
                }
            }

            vector<double> as(angleSet.begin(), angleSet.end());
            Point dir = Point(1, 0).scale(circles[i].r);
            for (double angle : as) {
                Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(angle));
                if (pointId.find(p) == pointId.end()) {
                    int id = pointId.size();
                    pointId[p] = id;
                    adj.push_back(unordered_set<int>());
                }
            }

            int m = as.size();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                Point p = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
                Point q = circles[i].o.add(dir.rotate(as[(j + 1) % m]));
                int u = pointId[p];
                int v = pointId[q];
                if (u != v) {
                    adj[u].insert(v);
                    adj[v].insert(u);
                }
            }
        }

        int v = adj.size();
        int e = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < v; ++i) {
            e += adj[i].size();
        }
        e /= 2;

        int comps = 0;
        vector<bool> visited(v, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < v; ++i) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                comps++;
                dfs(i, visited, adj);
            }
        }

        out << 1 + comps + e - v << '\n';
    }

private:
    void dfs(int i, vector<bool>& visited, vector<unordered_set<int>>& adj) {
        visited[i] = true;
        for (int j : adj[i]) {
            if (!visited[j]) {
                dfs(j, visited, adj);
            }
        }
    }

    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& c1, const Circle& c2) {
        double dx = c1.o.x - c2.o.x;
        double dy = c1.o.y - c2.o.y;
        double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d < eps) {
            // Concentric circles: keep original behavior (may produce NaN, but we ignore)
        }
        double cos = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
        if (cos < -1 - eps) return vector<Point>();
        if (cos < -1) cos = -1;
        if (cos > 1 + eps) return vector<Point>();
        if (cos > 1) cos = 1;
        double alpha = acos(cos);
        Point dir = c2.o.sub(c1.o).norm();
        vector<Point> res;
        res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(+alpha)));
        res.push_back(c1.o.add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
        return res;
    }
};

class FastScanner {
private:
    istream& in;
    string line;
    stringstream ss;
public:
    FastScanner(istream& input) : in(input) {}
    string next() {
        while (ss.str().empty() || ss.eof()) {
            if (!getline(in, line)) {
                throw runtime_error("No more input");
            }
            ss.clear();
            ss.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        ss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

int main() {
    FastScanner in(cin);
    ostream& out = cout;
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
